name: QFLS Audit Tickets Dump - Audit Platform

stages.native:
WITH
center_dim_filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM dwh_fitness_mart.center_dim
    WHERE 1 = 1
      [[AND {{ownership_type}}]]
),

audit_tickets AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM "pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system"."ticket"
    WHERE created_on_date >= date('2019-01-01')
      AND source = 'AUDIT_PLATFORM'
      AND labels IN (
          '[Quarterly FLS Audit]',
          '[Fitso Quarterly FLS Audit]',
          '[Lux Gym Quarterly FLS Audit]',
          '[Gym Equipment Safety Audit]'
      )
      [[AND {{priority}}]]
),

task_center_candidates AS (
    SELECT
        CAST(ti.id AS varchar) AS source_ref_id,
        cd.center_service_id,
        cd.center_name,
        cd.business_line,
        cd.ownership_type,
        cd.city_name,
        cd.center_type,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY ti.id
            ORDER BY CASE
                WHEN CAST(cd.gym_center_id AS varchar)
                     = regexp_extract(ti.target, '([0-9]+)$', 1)
                    THEN 1
                WHEN CAST(cd.center_service_id AS varchar)
                     = regexp_extract(ti.target, '([0-9]+)$', 1)
                    THEN 2
                ELSE 3
            END,
            cd.center_service_id
        ) AS row_filter
    FROM pk_curefitplatforms_task_management_system.task_instance ti
    JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            CAST(source_ref_id AS varchar) AS source_ref_id
        FROM audit_tickets
        WHERE source_ref_id IS NOT NULL
    ) ticket_refs
        ON CAST(ti.id AS varchar) = ticket_refs.source_ref_id
    LEFT JOIN center_dim_filtered cd
        ON CAST(cd.gym_center_id AS varchar)
           = regexp_extract(ti.target, '([0-9]+)$', 1)
        OR CAST(cd.center_service_id AS varchar)
           = regexp_extract(ti.target, '([0-9]+)$', 1)
    WHERE ti.created_on_date >= date('2019-01-01')
),

task_center_map AS (
    SELECT
        source_ref_id,
        center_service_id,
        center_name,
        business_line,
        ownership_type,
        city_name,
        center_type
    FROM task_center_candidates
    WHERE row_filter = 1
),

base_data AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        date(t.created_on) AS ticket_date,

        COALESCE(
            cd.center_service_id,
            loc_cd.center_service_id,
            task_cd.center_service_id
        ) AS center_service_id,

        COALESCE(
            cd.center_name,
            loc_cd.center_name,
            loc.center_name,
            task_cd.center_name
        ) AS center_name,

        COALESCE(
            cd.business_line,
            loc_cd.business_line,
            task_cd.business_line
        ) AS business_line,

        COALESCE(
            cd.ownership_type,
            loc_cd.ownership_type,
            task_cd.ownership_type
        ) AS ownership_type,

        t.status AS ticket_status,

        CASE
            WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
            ELSE t.due_date
        END AS ticket_due_time,

        tat_time.status_time AS ticket_closed_time,

        date_diff(
            'hour',
            t.created_on,
            tat_time.status_time
        ) AS tat_closure_hour,

        CASE
            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'on_hold')
                 AND tat_time.status_time IS NULL
                 AND now() <= (
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                             THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
                         ELSE t.due_date
                     END
                 )
                THEN 'open-within-SLA'

            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'on_hold')
                 AND tat_time.status_time IS NOT NULL
                 AND now() <= (
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                             THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
                         ELSE t.due_date
                     END
                 )
                THEN 'open-within-SLA'

            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'on_hold')
                 AND tat_time.status_time IS NULL
                 AND now() > (
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                             THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
                         ELSE t.due_date
                     END
                 )
                THEN 'open-SLA-Breached'

            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'on_hold')
                 AND tat_time.status_time IS NOT NULL
                 AND now() > (
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                             THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
                         ELSE t.due_date
                     END
                 )
                THEN 'open-SLA-Breached'

            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('done', 'resolved', 'rejected')
                 AND tat_time.status_time > (
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                             THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
                         ELSE t.due_date
                     END
                 )
                THEN 'Closed- SLA Breached'

            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('done', 'resolved', 'rejected')
                 AND tat_time.status_time IS NULL
                THEN 'Closed- Within SLA'

            WHEN lower(t.status) IN ('done', 'resolved', 'rejected')
                 AND tat_time.status_time <= (
                     CASE
                         WHEN t.due_date IS NULL
                             THEN t.created_on + interval '7' day
                         ELSE t.due_date
                     END
                 )
                THEN 'Closed- Within SLA'
        END AS SLA_status,

        tat_time.timest AS actual_working_hrs,

        COALESCE(
            cd.city_name,
            loc_cd.city_name,
            loc.city_name,
            task_cd.city_name
        ) AS city_name,

        CASE
            WHEN lower(
                COALESCE(
                    cd.center_name,
                    loc_cd.center_name,
                    loc.center_name,
                    task_cd.center_name
                )
            ) LIKE '%gold%'
                THEN 'GOLDS'
            ELSE COALESCE(
                cd.center_type,
                loc_cd.center_type,
                task_cd.center_type
            )
        END AS center_type,

        te.name AS type,
        aq.name AS queue_name,
        c.name AS L1_tag,
        t.created_on,
        t.id AS ticket_id,
        t.created_by,
        t.title AS checkpoint,
        t.description AS audit_observation,
        t.source,
        t.labels,

        CASE
            WHEN t.priority = 'P0' THEN 'Code_red'
            WHEN t.priority = 'P2' THEN 'High'
            WHEN t.priority = 'P5' THEN 'Medium'
            WHEN t.priority = 'P10' THEN 'Low'
            ELSE 'OTHERS'
        END AS priority_flag,

        t.assignees,
        sc.name AS L2_Tag,
        fd.field_value AS cost_per_ticket

    FROM audit_tickets t

    LEFT JOIN pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system.location loc
        ON t.location = loc.id

    LEFT JOIN pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system.location_source ls
        ON loc.location_source_id = ls.id

    LEFT JOIN center_dim_filtered cd
        ON CASE
            WHEN upper(trim(ls.name)) = 'CULT CENTERS'
                THEN CAST(cd.cult_center_id AS varchar)

            WHEN upper(trim(ls.name)) = 'GYM CENTERS'
                THEN CAST(cd.gym_center_id AS varchar)

            WHEN upper(trim(ls.name)) IN (
                'FITSO CENTERS',
                'FITNESS FIRST',
                'PLAY CENTERS',
                'PRO CENTERS',
                'LUX CENTERS'
            )
                THEN CAST(cd.center_service_id AS varchar)
        END = trim(CAST(loc.reference_id AS varchar))

    LEFT JOIN center_dim_filtered loc_cd
        ON CAST(loc_cd.center_service_id AS varchar)
           = trim(CAST(loc.center_service_ref_id AS varchar))

    LEFT JOIN task_center_map task_cd
        ON CAST(t.source_ref_id AS varchar) = task_cd.source_ref_id

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT
            ticket_id,

            SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN minu > 0
                         AND dow NOT IN (7)
                        THEN minu
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ) / 60.0 AS timest,

            MAX(status_time) AS status_time,
            MAX(to_value) AS to_value

        FROM (
            SELECT
                CAST(t2.id AS varchar) AS ticket_id,
                day_of_week(dd.full_date) AS dow,
                dd.full_date,
                sq.status_time,
                sq.to_value,

                date_diff(
                    'minute',
                    GREATEST(
                        t2.created_on,
                        CAST(
                            CONCAT(
                                CAST(date(dd.full_date) AS varchar),
                                ' 08:00:00.000'
                            ) AS timestamp
                        )
                    ),
                    LEAST(
                        COALESCE(
                            sq.status_time,
                            CAST(
                                CONCAT(
                                    CAST(date(dd.full_date) AS varchar),
                                    ' 19:00:00.000'
                                ) AS timestamp
                            )
                        ),
                        CAST(
                            CONCAT(
                                CAST(date(dd.full_date) AS varchar),
                                ' 19:00:00.000'
                            ) AS timestamp
                        )
                    )
                ) AS minu

            FROM audit_tickets t2

            LEFT JOIN (
                SELECT *
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        entity_id AS ticket_id,
                        last_modified_on AS status_time,
                        json_extract_scalar(
                            changes,
                            '$[0].from'
                        ) AS from_value,
                        json_extract_scalar(
                            changes,
                            '$[0].to'
                        ) AS to_value,
                        changes,

                        row_number() OVER (
                            PARTITION BY entity_id
                            ORDER BY last_modified_on DESC
                        ) AS row_filter

                    FROM pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system.audit_event

                    WHERE entity = 'Ticket'
                      AND json_extract_scalar(
                          changes,
                          '$[0].field'
                      ) = 'status'
                      AND lower(
                          json_extract_scalar(
                              changes,
                              '$[0].to'
                          )
                      ) IN ('done', 'resolved')
                      AND created_on_date >= date('2019-01-01')
                ) temp

                WHERE row_filter = 1
            ) sq
                ON sq.ticket_id = CAST(t2.id AS varchar)

            LEFT JOIN dwh_curefit.dim_date dd
                ON dd.full_date BETWEEN date(t2.created_on)
                AND COALESCE(
                    date(sq.status_time),
                    date(now())
                )
        ) working_hours

        GROUP BY 1
    ) tat_time
        ON tat_time.ticket_id = CAST(t.id AS varchar)

    LEFT JOIN "pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system"."Assignee_queue" aq
        ON t.assignee_queue_id = aq.id

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM "pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system"."Category"
        WHERE 1 = 1
          [[AND {{L1_tag}}]]
    ) c
        ON c.id = t.category_id

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM "pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system"."Sub_Category"
        WHERE 1 = 1
          [[AND {{L2_Tag}}]]
    ) sc
        ON sc.id = t.sub_category_id

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM "pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system"."tenant"
        WHERE 1 = 1
          [[AND {{Tenant_type}}]]
    ) te
        ON te.id = t.tenant_id

    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT DISTINCT
            ticket_id,
            name AS field_name,
            field_id,
            value AS field_value

        FROM (
            SELECT *
            FROM pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system.field_data
            WHERE created_on_date > date('2019-01-01')
        ) a

        JOIN (
            SELECT DISTINCT
                name,
                tenant_id,
                sub_category_id,
                data_source_id,
                id,
                category_id,
                last_modified_on,
                created_on,
                active,
                created_by

            FROM pk_curefitplatforms_ticketing_system.field

            WHERE id IN (830, 783)
        ) b
            ON a.field_id = b.id
    ) fd
        ON t.id = fd.ticket_id

    WHERE date(t.created_on_date) BETWEEN {{sd}} AND {{ed}}
)

SELECT *
FROM base_data
